info.name: Tequipy Orders Sandbox
info.description: 29 requests for the public sandbox API. Uses a read-write Bearer token. Send discovery requests 01–03, set companyEntityId, employeeId and equipmentId, then run all folders in order with one iteration. Each full run creates three orders: two delivered, one cancelled. Sandbox notifications may be sent. This collection covers orders only.

exec: if (baseUrl !== "https://dev.backend.tequipy.com/integration") { pm.execution.setNextRequest(null); pm.execution.skipRequest(); throw new Error("Use the supplied sandbox baseUrl."); }
if (!pm.environment.get("token")) { pm.execution.setNextRequest(null); pm.execution.skipRequest(); throw new Error("Select the sandbox environment and set your local token value."); }
